gloss: to close up completely; to shut tight

definitions.gloss: to close up completely; to keep shut
definitions.explanation: To close doors, windows, or curtains completely and leave them that way, often for an extended period. Implies sealing a space off from the outside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閉|し}め{切|き}って⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I closed all the windows tight and went out.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閉|し}め{切|き}ったままだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}くて→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧。
examples.english: Keeping the curtains shut all the time makes the room dark and lowers my mood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{使|つか}っていない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{閉|し}め{切|き}っておく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}できる→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Keeping unused rooms closed up during winter helps save on heating costs.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧ (to close) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to do thoroughly). The 〜きる suffix here signals completeness — not just closing, but closing entirely and keeping closed.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閉|し}め{切|き}る: to keep the windows closed
- ⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閉|し}め{切|き}る: to keep the curtains closed
- ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閉|し}め{切|き}る: to keep the door closed
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{閉|し}め{切|き}る: to seal off a room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close — neutral, just the action of closing
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}る→締め切る：05743_shimekiru⟧ (05743): to set a deadline; to close registration — homophone, different kanji and meaning
- ⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close (a book, eyes) — used for things that fold or come together
